visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a realistic brown toy cockroach rapidly vibrating and moving across a light-colored wooden floor. The camera captures a person's legs in dark pants standing nearby in a bright room with a white wall backdrop, creating a sense of immediate action. (2) Joe, an Asian man with glasses wearing a black hoodie and a backward black cap, presents a cylindrical white mailing tube. He stands in a hobby room packed with model kits and collectibles. He then unrolls a large, vibrant Gundam poster and shows a thick character art book with detailed drawings. (3) Joe reaches into a cardboard box and extracts a retail-packaged toy called Robo Alive Cockroach by Zuru. He uses a silver utility knife to slice the tape on the plastic box. He holds the toy cockroach in his palm, showing its long antennae and articulated legs to the camera. (4) The toy cockroach is placed on a wooden table surface covered with paper and posters. It scurries quickly in circles while Joe's hand reaches out to touch its back. The camera follows the toy's erratic movement closely with a slightly shaky handheld perspective to capture the speed. (5) Joe holds the cockroach toy directly in front of his face, pointing at its realistic texture and large size compared to a real insect. He has an excited expression, smiling and talking directly to the camera in his studio setting filled with figures and lighting equipment. (6) The scene shifts to Joe pranking a friend in a grey hoodie. Joe releases the toy on the floor, and the friend jumps back in surprise, waving his hands and screaming. The video ends with Joe laughing and holding the toy, looking highly amused at the reaction.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sudden, high-pitched male scream of terror opens the audio track, immediately followed by the high-frequency mechanical whirring and buzzing of a vibrating motor. The background atmosphere is quiet until the vocal outburst occurs, creating a high-arousal start. (2) A fast-paced, energetic male narrator speaks in Taiwanese Mandarin with clear articulation and high enthusiasm. The background music is an upbeat, mid-tempo pop-rock track with a steady drum beat. Audible sounds of crisp paper rustling and thick poster sheets unrolling are prominent. (3) The sound of a metal cutter clicking and then slicing through plastic adhesive tape creates a sharp, high-frequency transient effect. The narrator's voice maintains a friendly and animated tone while a new, quirky and comedic synth melody begins to play in the background. (4) The audio transitions into a high-energy electronic track with heavy bass and rapid percussion. The primary sound is the continuous, gritty scratching and rattling of the toy cockroach's plastic legs vibrating against a hard wooden surface, creating a dense mechanical texture. (5) The mix is dominated by multiple male voices shouting and screaming in a chaotic but humorous manner. Rapid footsteps and the sound of objects being bumped are audible over the loud, climaxing music. The audio concludes with the main speaker's calm, satisfied commentary.
